+
+    fqcn, doc = RoleMixin()._build_doc('example', '/role/path', collection, argspec)
+
+    assert fqcn == expected_name
+    assert doc == {'path': '/role/path', 'collection': collection, 'entry_points': argspec}

+
+

+    ({}, None, None),

+    monkeypatch.setattr(mixin, '_load_argspec',

+
+    assert mixin._create_role_doc(('plain', 'included'), ('/roles',), 'alternate') == {
